male.name: 阿井田 茂
male.credit: AivisSpeech: 阿井田 茂 (voice/model: 古山キリヲ)

tracks.title: Yesterday at the community center

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 昨日の朝、図書館で日本語を勉強しました。
turns.english: Yesterday morning, I studied Japanese at the library.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 午後も勉強しましたか。
turns.english: Did you study in the afternoon too?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: いいえ、午後は勉強しませんでした。友達と映画を見ました。
turns.english: No, I didn't study in the afternoon. I watched a movie with a friend.

comprehensionPrompts: Where did he study yesterday morning?
Did he study in the afternoon?
What did he do with his friend?

tracks.title: Tomorrow's plans

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 明日の朝、九時に公園へ行きます。
turns.english: Tomorrow morning, I'll go to the park at nine.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 午後は買い物をしますか。
turns.english: Will you go shopping in the afternoon?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: いいえ、買い物はしません。午後は家で本を読みます。
turns.english: No, I won't go shopping. I'll read a book at home in the afternoon.

comprehensionPrompts: When will she go to the park?
Will she shop in the afternoon?
Where will she read in the afternoon?
